import { Note, NoteId, NoteText } from "{{scope}}/notebook/domain";

/** A stored row back into the domain; a row the domain refuses is corrupt data. */
export function toNote(row: { readonly id: string; readonly text: string }): Note {
  const id = NoteId.parse(row.id);
  const text = NoteText.parse(row.text);
  if (!id.ok || !text.ok) throw new Error(`corrupt note row ${row.id}`);
  return new Note(id.value, text.value);
}
